title: Does the Moon really change shape?

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: Can I ask you something about the Moon's shape?

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: Why does the Moon change shape?

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: It doesn't. The Moon only reflects sunlight, and we see more or less of its lit side as it goes around us.

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: How long until it looks the same again?

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: About twenty-nine and a half days from one new moon to the next.
